page.overview:
Who is Sea Slug?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;"

!style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Sea Slugs were introduced in 1987, boxed exclusively with the Sea Ray. They were also available in 1998 and discontinued in 1989. ---- Appearance: purple helmet with red trim and silver goggles; purple short-sleeved shirt with black shoulder armor and gloves; purple pants with silver belt and yellow holster; purple boots with black covering

Accessories: dark grey pistol with indented front grip and fin on top. ---- [http://www.yojoe.com/action/87/seaslug.shtml YoJoe.com page]/[http://www.yojoe.com/filecard/87/seaslug.shtml Filecard]
